acceptance_criteria: loop-bound and lineage-eviction matrix; CHK-08, NEG-09, NEG-10.
statement: When the matrix exercises loop bounds, a request whose causal parent is already retained in the accepted guard loop window **or** in the action-path emission-time lineage window **shall** be `Rejected`/`LoopBound` with zero emission and zero journal; `causation_id == 0` **shall never** be a loop rejection; and the lineage window **shall never** exceed its declared depth and **shall** evict the oldest identity.
title: T029 requirement 007
